sn55.53:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Bārānasiyaṃ viharati Isipatane Migadāye || || 2.
sn55.53:1.2: Atha kho Dhammadinno upāsako pañcahi upāsakasatehi saddhiṃ yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Dhammadinno upāsako Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3.
sn55.53:1.4: anusāsatu no bhante Bhagavā yam amhākam assa dīgharattam hitāya sukhāyā ti || ||
sn55.53:2.1: Tasmā ti ha vo Dhammadinna evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ || ||
sn55.53:2.2: Ye te suttantā Tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīratthā lokuttarā suññatapaṭisaṃyuttā || te kālena kālam upasampajja viharissāmā ti || || Evaṃ
sn55.53:2.4: Na kho netam bhante sukaram amhehi puttasambādhasayanam ajjhāvasantehi kāsikaṃ candanam paccanubhontehi mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhārayantehi jātarūparajataṃ sādiyantehi ||
sn55.53:2.5: ye te suttantā gambhīrā gambhīratthā lokuttarā suññatapaṭisaṃyuttā te kālena kālam upasampajja viharituṃ || ||
sn55.53:2.6: Tesaṃ no bhante Bhagavā amhākam pañcasu sikkhāpadesu ṭhitānam uttaridhammaṃ desetū ti || || 5.
sn55.53:3.1: Tasmā ti ha vo Dhammadinna evam sikkhitabbaṃ ||
sn55.53:3.3: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.53:3.6: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgata bhavissāma akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehī ti || || Evaṃ
sn55.53:4.1: Yānimāni bhante Bhagavatā cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni desitāni || saṃvijjante te dhammā amhesu mayañ ca tesu dhammesu sandissāma || || 6.
sn55.53:4.2: Mayaṃ hi bhante Buddhe aveccappasadena samannāgatā ||
sn55.53:4.3: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.53:4.6: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgatā akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehī ti || || 7.
sn55.53:4.7: Lābhā vo Dhammadinna suladdhaṃ vo Dhammadinna
